name: Naga
traitOneDesc:
Nagas unique form leave them well adapted for grappling.
When you have a target grappled, your hands are still free.
You have +3 saves to saves against becoming and escaping grappled or restrained.
traitTwoDesc:
Nagas sharp claws make for good weapons in a pinch.
Unarmed Attack. 
Deals 1d4 slashing damage. (Finesse, Agile)
traitThreeDesc:
Nagas are one of the most magically inclined species and most nagas pick up at least some spells.
Learn two apprentice level spells
traitFourDesc:
Nagas are slightly slower than most, but can move in bursts of motion that make them hard to track.
4 Tiles Land Speed.
You can Step 2 tiles, or 1 tile onto difficult terrain

name: Yirte
traitOneDesc:
Yirtes live in the forests and jungles, and are used to climbing the trees of their homeland
4 tiles climbing speed
traitTwoDesc:
While they may be small in size, Yirte are fierce and ready to defend themselves by claw if needs be.
Unarmed Attack. 
Deals 1d4 slashing damage. (Finesse, Agile)
traitThreeDesc:
Yirte are fast runners and decent climbers
6 Tiles Land Speed
4 Tiles Climbing Speed
traitFourDesc:
Yirte can easily camoflage themselves in the forests they live.
You have +3 bonus to stealth checks when hiding among foliage and plantlife

name: Gnome
traitOneDesc:
Gnomes natural connection to magic allow them to absorb magical effects
Reaction, when you take elemental damage Reduce it by 1d4. Increases by 1d4 every other level. Twice per day.
traitTwoDesc: Become trained in one intelligence skill of your choice. Can change it on level up
traitThreeDesc:
You have one level one [Gadget].
If stolen or destroyed you can make a new one with an hours downtime.

name: Vesper
traitOneDesc:
Vespers are the only sapient humanoid species that can fly, though their fighting abilities are limited while they do
4 tile flying speed, cannot be used while wearing heavy armored or encumbered
You cannot use two handed weapons while flying
You take a -3 penalty on other attacks or spellshaping checks while flying using their natural flight
traitTwoDesc:
Having lived for long in the dark caves, Vespers see well in darker environments
You have low-light vision
traitThreeDesc:
While not true echolocation Vespers ears are sensitive, though this makes loud noises dangerous.
You have a +3 bonus on perception relying on hearing.
-3 Penalty on saves against effects that does thunder damage or inflict the defined condition
traitFourDesc:
Vespers lightweight bones make them bad brawlers and leave them struggling in heavy winds
You count as one size smaller when it comes to grappling
-3 penalty on saves against wind effects while flying

name: Human
traitOneDesc:
Humans are enduring, pressing beyond their limits
The first time you would be fatigued each day ignore it

name: Dragonkin
traitOneDesc:
Dragonkin can use their powerful tail to stand firm against blows that would move them
Reaction, when you save against being knocked prone, off-guard or moved against your will, Add your PHY to the roll
traitTwoDesc:
Dragonkin have sharper claws, though perhaps with less finesse
Unarmed Attack. 
Deals 1d6 slashing damage. (Agile)
traitThreeDesc:
Dragonkin scales are tough and many have been saved by a glancing blow
You have a +1 bonus to Reflex and Fortitude saving throws.
traitFourDesc:
Once per hour you can add +2 to a D20 roll.
If you critically fail on this on roll you become frightened 1

name: Aruna
traitOneDesc:
Aruna wings cannot provide true flight, but they can glide between 
You have a 6 tile Glide speed when not restrained. 
When falling, you can use a reaction to spread your wingarms, preventing any fall damage.
traitTwoDesc:
Aruna possess sharp talons and know how to fight them.
Unarmed Attack. 
Deals 1d4 slashing damage. (Finesse, Agile)
traitThreeDesc:
You have a 4 tile swim speed. 
You can hold your breath for a minute plus twice your PHY rounds.

name: Troll
traitOneDesc:
Trolls have a natural regeneration that they can channel to recover
Can spend a minute to regenerate a 1d8 health. 
Twice per long rest.
traitTwoDesc:
The through hide of trolls allow them shrug of damage
Has resistance 2 to physical damage.
traitThreeDesc:
Whenever you force a creature 8 or more tiles away to make a Reflex or Fortitude saving throw, they have a +2 bonus to the save.
-3 To visual perception checks targeting things beyond 8 tiles

name: Brannur
traitOneDesc:
Brannur are strong and tough
You have a +2 bonus to athletics checks to carry and break things.
traitTwoDesc:
The red eyes of brannur allow them to see in dark. It has scared many foes.
You have low-light vision.
You can make visual intimidation checks without penalties
traitThreeDesc:
Brannur can resists things that might put most down.
Once per day you may choose to reroll a saving throw.
